name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester), about 5 minutes from LAX.
Open since 1952.
Hours: Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM, Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call to confirm late night.
Happy hour is 3-6 PM every day.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: Taco Tuesday. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3.
Taco Tuesday: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas.
Melody Rewards is free to join. You get 100 welcome points.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Rewards: 250 pts free soft drink or Melody Fries, 500 pts $10 off your check, 1,000 pts free starter, 1,500 pts free entrée up to $21.50.
One reward per visit, one prize per day, no stacking. Rewards are never free alcohol.
A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it.
Birthday bonus: +250 points once a year.
Refer a friend: +100 points when they join with your code and make a first visit. They get 100 welcome points too.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
Melody Approach is a free flying game with Campaign and Survival weekly leaderboards that reset every Monday.
Game rewards are in BETA and switched off for now: boards are for bragging rights only.
Once game rewards are on: 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day.
Games Pack: Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix, Truth or Dare, LA Scoreboard and Who Wins picks.
Order from your phone: pick bar, patio, to go, or scan your table code. Pay your server or bartender like normal.
Free parking, including a free lot for people picking up travelers.
Every week: karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.
No cover to watch the game.
LAX crew get 10% off the check with a badge (dine-in, can't combine with other promos).
The app has 12 languages and needs no download.
Nearby alerts and location are optional and only work while the app is open.

qa.a: Mon-Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM, and Sat-Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late night.
Weekdays at 11 AM and weekends at 9 AM. Call (310) 670-1994 if you want to double-check.
We list 1:30 AM every night, but hours can vary. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late night.
I don't have the kitchen close time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, in Westchester. Tap Directions in the app to get there.

qa.q: How far are you from LAX?
qa.a: We're about 5 minutes from LAX. You can also walk it in about 15 minutes.
Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals. Head toward the rideshare lot and Sepulveda, go north about a block, and cross.
Yes, parking is free, including a free lot for people picking up travelers. There's also street parking nearby.
(310) 670-1994. You can also tap Call in the app.
Tap the Directions button in the Visit Melody section of the app.
Yes, we're minutes from SoFi Stadium and Intuit Dome. The app's route game even flies past the stadium in Inglewood.
I don't have a booking system to point you to. Call (310) 670-1994 and staff can tell you.
Yes, we host private parties of about 10 to 150 guests, with a private party room that has a pool table. Call (310) 670-1994 to inquire.
Yes, Melody offers catering. Call (310) 670-1994 for details.

qa.q: Do you do delivery or takeout?
qa.a: Takeout is available, and delivery goes through DoorDash. In the app you can also choose To go when you order.
We take American Express, Discover, Mastercard and Visa. You pay your server or bartender, not in the app.
Yes, there's free Wi-Fi.
Yes, there's an outdoor patio, and you can pick Patio when you order in the app.
We've seen it listed as wheelchair accessible, but I don't have details. Please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is it kid friendly? Can I bring kids?
qa.a: Melody hosts kids' birthday parties by day. I don't have an evening or late-night age policy, so ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
I don't have a dress code. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
I don't have that detail. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
There's no cover to watch the game. For late DJ nights I don't have the info, so ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
Happy hour is 3-6 PM every day.
The app lists happy hour as 3-6 daily. We've seen $8 well drinks and $1 off drafts, but ask staff for today's full list.
Yes, happy hour is 3-6 every day.
Mon: half off burgers 11-3. Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11-3. Fri: $3 sliders 11-3. Happy hour is 3-6 daily.
Half off burgers, 11-3.
Taco Tuesday: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas.

qa.q: What are the Taco Tuesday hours?
qa.a: Taco Tuesday runs 11 AM to midnight on Tuesdays.

qa.q: What are the Taco Tuesday tacos?
qa.a: Classic tacos are $4 each: Chicken, Steak, Carnitas, Dockside Fish, Shrimp, Salmon, Avocado, Beyond and Vegan Carnitas. Elevated tacos are $6.99 each: Baja Shrimp Taco Melt, Smash Burger Taco and Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken Taco.
Half off sandwiches, 11-3.
$3 sliders, 11-3.
The app doesn't list a Wednesday food special. Wednesday nights have karaoke from about 10 PM.
Every week we have karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.
Karaoke is weekly, on Wednesdays from about 10 PM. Call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.
We have DJs weekly. Past schedules had Friday and Saturday night DJs and a Sunday DJ, but call (310) 670-1994 to confirm.
Trivia is on our weekly lineup, but I don't have the day or time. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994. You can also play trivia in the app anytime.
Yes, every game is on the TVs. We've done NFL Sunday watch parties and Monday and Thursday night football, with no cover.

qa.q: Where can I watch the game?
qa.a: Right here. Every game is on the TVs. The Sports tab in the app shows today's LA and California games and where to watch them.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap to join in the app. It's free, takes about 10 seconds, and gives you a gold Melody Rewards card on your phone plus 100 welcome points.
Yes, joining is free. One account per person.

qa.q: Do I need to download an app?
qa.a: No download needed. It opens in your phone's browser, and you can add it to your Home Screen. Find us via Instagram @melodylax (link in bio) or scan the QR code on your table.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: Use your browser's Add to Home Screen option. On iPhone, notifications need the app on your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer).

qa.q: Is there a wallet card for Apple or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Not yet. For now you carry your gold Melody Rewards card inside the app.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: You get 100 welcome points when you join.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases (before tip). You also get bonuses for joining, your birthday, referrals and, once game rewards are on, playing games.
10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app, then snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date. Once our register is connected this will be automatic.

qa.q: What are the rules for adding a visit?
qa.a: The date can be today or yesterday. It's one receipt per member per day, each check only once, and up to $150 per check. Claims are checked against our sales report, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do I earn points on the games?
qa.a: Game rewards are in BETA and switched off for now. Once on, you can earn up to 50 game points a day.
I don't have an expiration rule. Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff for details.

qa.q: Can I use my points at Nalu Vida?
qa.a: No. Melody has its own points balance, and points don't move between restaurants.

250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: $10 off your check. 1,000 pts: free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,500 pts: free entrée up to $21.50. Check your rewards card in the app for what you can use now.

qa.q: What does a free entrée reward cover?
qa.a: Any entrée up to $21.50, such as Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries. It costs 1,500 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. A used or expired code never works again.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day (Los Angeles date), with no stacking. A second prize that day shows Come back tomorrow.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Can I give my points or rewards to someone?
qa.a: No, rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Do you have levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't have any levels or VIP tiers listed. Rewards are based on your points balance.
Yes. You get +250 points once a year on your birthday as a Melody Rewards member.
Tap Text a friend on your member card to send your invite link. Your friend joins with your code and comes in. You get +100 points and they get 100 welcome points.

qa.q: When do I get my referral points?
qa.a: Referral points pay once per friend, after their first visit.

qa.q: Can I use my own referral code or change it?
qa.a: No. You can enter one friend's code, once, when you join. It can't be changed later and you can't use your own.
Yes, +100 points, once per member. Turn on nearby alerts (location and notifications), then open the app on at least 3 different days spanning at least 7 days. It's added automatically.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for leaving a review?
qa.a: Yes, the app gives +50 points once per member for telling us how we did.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird or founding-member gift?
qa.a: The rules mention an early-bird / founding-member gift, but I don't have details. Ask staff.
10% off your first order today when you show a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours. It's one per guest per day and can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: How do I use Just Landed?
qa.a: Tap I just landed in the app to get a code, then show your boarding pass to your server.

qa.q: Is there a discount for airport or LAX workers?
qa.a: Yes, LAX crew get 10% off with a badge or proof of employment. It's dine-in only and can't be combined with other promos.

qa.q: Can I order from my table?
qa.a: Yes. Scan your table QR code, or pick your table, the bar, patio or To go in the app. Add items and tap Send my order.

qa.q: How do I order at the bar or patio?
qa.a: In the app under Where are you sitting?, tap I'm at the bar or Patio, then add items and send your order.
Yes, choose To go in the app. The app says we'll text you when it's ready.
Pay your server or bartender like normal. The app doesn't take payment.

qa.q: Do I earn points when I order in the app?
qa.a: Yes, you earn points on every check as a member.
Starters, Mac & Cheese, Burgers, Fries, Soups, Tacos & Burritos, Taco Tuesday specials and Drinks. Browse them under the Menu tab.

Lemon Pepper Wings $16, Avocado Toast $13, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites $15, Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries $16, Chicken Pot Stickers $15, Fried Green Beans $13, Fried Shrimp $18.25, Jalapeno Calamari $16, Lettuce Wraps $16 and Baby Back Ribs & Fries $20.25.

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese do you have?
qa.a: Lobster $21.50, Melody Burger Mac $19.25, Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeno $17.25, Parmesan & Mushroom $17.25, Chicken Parmesan $18.25 and House Mac $15.
Yes, the Melody Burger is $19.25: Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries. Mondays are half off burgers 11-3.
Gilroy Garlic Fries $6.75, Melody Fries $5.75, Onion Strings $9.75, Phat Fries $7.75, Philly Cheese Steak Fries $17.25 and Sweet Potato Fries $7.75. Cheese is +$2 on Melody and Phat Fries.
French Onion, Tomato Bisque and Black Bean, each as a cup or a bowl. Cups are $9.75-$11 and bowls are $14-$15.

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos are 2 per order: Shrimp $16, Salmon $16, Carnitas $14, Chicken $13, Avocado $13 and Beyond $14. Burritos: Carnitas $18.25, Steak $18.25, Chicken $17.25 and Bean & Cheese $14. Plus Nachos $15 and Cheese Quesadilla $15.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
qa.a: Yes. Menu items include Beyond Tacos, Avocado Tacos, Avocado Toast, and on Tuesdays a Vegan Carnitas Taco. For allergies, ask staff.

Mango Margarita, House Margarita, Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, Draft Beer, Mimosa, Round of Shots and a Bucket of Beers (5). Tap a drink in the app to see it poured.
Examples: House Margarita $12, Mango Margarita $12, Old Fashioned $14, Moscow Mule $13, Draft Beer $8, Mimosa $10. Drink prices in the app are previews, so your bill may differ.

qa.q: How much is a margarita on Tuesday?
qa.a: The House Margarita is $6 on Tuesdays and $12 on other days.

qa.q: Are food prices in the app accurate?
qa.a: Food prices come from Melody's menu. Drink prices and some menu photos are previews until Melody signs off.

qa.q: Can I see a 3D or spinning view of a dish?
qa.a: Yes, some items have a Spin in 3D or See it spin button on the menu, like Lemon Pepper Wings, Ribs, Nachos and the Melody Burger.
It's our free arcade flying game. Fly a plane over LA, shoot jets, UFOs and choppers, dodge fire, and catch Melody's food and music notes. It has Campaign and Survival modes.

qa.q: How do I play Melody Approach?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap the boost button for speed, and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.

10 levels of about 45 seconds each, following a SoCal route from LAX to Hollywood, Venice, Inglewood, Compton and Long Beach, then back to LAX. Each level gets harder, with six boss fights (levels 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10).
There's no finish line. The game keeps getting harder until your plane goes down, and your time survived is your score.

qa.q: How do I lose in Melody Approach?
qa.a: Three hits and your plane goes down, and the game is over. Every enemy attack is warned first, so watch for the warnings.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses (or flying longer in Survival) unlocks stronger guns, and ammo crates refill them.
Yes. Pause and turn combat off for a calm flight where nothing can hurt your plane.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. It's free to play, with or without an account, and no purchase is needed.

qa.q: How often can I play the games?
qa.a: I don't see a limit on plays. Game points do have a daily cap once rewards are on.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two boards, Campaign (ranked by score) and Survival (ranked by longest time). Both reset every Monday. Practice flights don't go on the boards.

qa.q: How do I post my score?
qa.a: After your flight, tap Post my score to put it on the board.

qa.q: What do I win on the weekly leaderboard?
qa.a: Right now it's bragging rights only, because game rewards are in BETA. Once on, the top player on each board may win the weekly prize shown in the game, currently Free Melody Fries.

qa.q: When are the weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: The boards reset every Monday. Prizes aren't switched on yet, and I don't have details on how winners are picked or contacted. Ask staff.

qa.q: How many points do I get from the flying game?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on, it's 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day (Los Angeles date). Right now no game points are given.

qa.q: Are cheaters removed from the board?
qa.a: Yes, scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: What is the Melody Games Pack?
qa.a: Live LA scores, Trivia, Sports Trivia, Truth or Dare and the daily Melody Word, plus Melody Mix. Play solo or pass the phone around the table.
Pick a category, answer each question before the timer runs out, and faster right answers score more. Play solo for 10 questions or pass the phone with 2-6 players.
It works like Trivia, with NBA, NFL, MLB, soccer and LA team questions. You can also pick your favorite team for a 10-question Fan Test and a 1-5 star Fan Rating.

qa.q: How do I earn points from Trivia?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on, you get 1 point per 2 right answers, up to 5 a round. Games Pack points max out at 10 a day.
One daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone that day. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints, and a new word comes every day at midnight LA time.

qa.q: How many points does Melody Word give?
qa.a: Once rewards are on, solving the daily word gives 3 points, or 2 with 1 hint, or 1 with 2 hints.
A timed word scramble game. Unscramble words using the hint, with 3 skips. Once rewards are on, you get 1 point per 2 words, up to 3.
A table game for 1-6 players with light truths and fun dares, 3 turns each. It's just for fun, with no points. Dares never involve drinking, and anyone can pass.
It shows live scores from ESPN for LA and California teams, with where to watch. It's for information only, with no streams.

qa.q: What is the Who wins? pick?
qa.a: A free, just-for-fun pick of who'll win a game, with no money or wagers. Picks lock when the game starts. Once rewards are on, a right pick earns 2 points, up to 6 a day.

A free board for NFL and college games. Entries close at kickoff, when the numbers are drawn at random. At the end of Q1, halftime, Q3 and the final, the last digit of each team's score picks the winning square.

qa.q: How do I get a Football Squares entry?
qa.a: Every member can tap Get my free square for one free square per board. Extra squares come with a purchase: show your Rewards card and staff add a ticket. Each board has a per-person limit.

qa.q: What can I win in Football Squares?
qa.a: Prizes are set per board and shown on it before you play, like food, merch, % off the check or a non-alcoholic drink. There are no cash, gift card or free alcohol prizes. Claim them at Melody with your Rewards card.
The app has a kid mode, and some adult-oriented games are hidden when it's on. For details, ask staff.

qa.q: What languages is the app in?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages.

qa.q: What is the nearby alerts feature?
qa.a: It's optional. If you turn it on, the app uses your location only while it's open to show a You're nearby deal within about half a mile, and you can turn it off anytime in the app or your phone's Settings.
Only if you opt in, and only while the app is open. Nothing runs in the background. Your exact location stays on your phone, and it's never sold or shared.

qa.q: What does the app record when I open it?
qa.a: The time, a short device summary, a random phone ID, your member ID if you joined, and an approximate location (about 1 km) only if you turned location on. It's used for rewards limits, fraud prevention and visit stats, seen only by the restaurant owner and SousShift AI, and never sold.
No. Your data is never sold and not used for ads.

qa.q: Can I get help from staff?
qa.a: Yes, flag down your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Who do I talk to about a complaint?
qa.a: Please tell a manager at Melody or call (310) 670-1994.
